questions.question: Explain the HTTP protocol and its role in communication between a web browser and a web server. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• HTTP stands for Hyper Text Transfer Protocol. It is used for communication between a web browser
  • and a web server. The browser sends an HTTP request to the web server to access a webpage or
  • resource. The web server processes the request and sends an HTTP response containing the requested
  • data or a status code. HTTP transfers web content such as HTML pages, images, CSS files, and
  • JavaScript files. HTTP is stateless, meaning each request is handled independently. HTTPS is the secure
  • version of HTTP that uses encryption to protect data. [U][CO1]

questions.question: Differentiate between parent(), parents(), children(), and find() in j Query. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• parent(): Selects the immediate parent element of the selected element.
  • parents(): Selects all ancestor elements of the selected element.
  • children(): Selects all direct child elements of the selected element.
  • find(): Selects all matching descendant elements at any level inside the selected element.
  • Example:
  • $("p").parent() – Selects the immediate parent of

    .

  • $("p").parents() – Selects all ancestors of

    .

  • $("div").children() – Selects direct children of
    .
  • $("div").find("p") – Selects all descendant

    elements inside

    . [U][CO2]
